mentions.name: RL pixel platformer sandbox
mentions.description: An RL pixel platformer sandbox that explores reinforcement learning and self-play, featuring a playable RL agent, described as a cross between JumpMan Jr and Spelunky 2. A very early demo with the agent is available online.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an RL pixel platformer sandbox to learn RL and explore self-play with a playable RL agent. It’s a cross between JumpMan Jr and Spelunky 2.
